SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TAX_BILL_NO FROM IF_KEPTAPDT WHERE STATUS = 'D' AND IF_SEND_FLAG = 'N' AND SITE = 'PA' ORDER BY TAX_BILL_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT '$G_RS.TAX_BILL_NO$' FROM DUAL
UPDATE IF_KEPTAPDT SET IF_SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , IF_SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') , IF_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = '$G_RS.TAX_BILL_NO$'
UPDATE IF_KEPTAPDT SET IF_SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , IF_SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') , IF_SEND_FLAG = 'E' WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = '$G_RS.TAX_BILL_NO$'
